prompt_text: Best all-in-one fundraising platform for nonprofits
response_text:
The **best all-in-one fundraising platform** for nonprofits depends on whether you value *lowest cost* or *broadest feature set*, but the strongest options in your results are **Givebutter**, **GoFundMe Pro**, and **Zeffy**.[1][2][9]

- **Best overall value:** **Givebutter** — it positions itself as all-in-one fundraising software with **0% platform fees**, built-in rewards, and integrated donor management tools; it also says it is ranked #1 on G2 for fundraising, donor management, nonprofit CRM, and auctions.[2]
- **Best for established nonprofits wanting a branded platform:** **GoFundMe Pro** — it emphasizes **branded campaigns**, intelligent tools, and donation forms, and markets itself as the **#1 fundraising platform for nonprofits**.[1]
- **Best for truly free fundraising:** **Zeffy** — it claims to be the **only 100% free fundraising software** for nonprofits.[9]

If you want a single recommendation, **Givebutter** is usually the best default pick for most nonprofits because it combines fundraising, donor management, and campaign tools in one platform while advertising **0% fees**.[2]

If you want, I can also give you a **side-by-side comparison** of Givebutter vs GoFundMe Pro vs Zeffy based on fees, CRM, events, and payment processing.
